title: Palantir Stock (PLTR) Rises 5.5% as AI Stocks Rebound (Nov 9)
summary: Palantir (PLTR) closed at $169.20 on Nov 9, up 5.50%, as financial media tied the gain to a rebound in AI stocks after the prior week's selloff.
body_markdown:
## Why Palantir Stock Rose


Financial media tied the gain mainly to a broader rebound in AI stocks. According to[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/palantir-rises-5-snowflake-6-182950732.html) , Palantir rose with no company-specific news as buyers returned to higher-growth AI names after[the previous week's AI selloff](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nasdaq-record-point-loss-ai-stock-rout-wipes-25-trillion-us-futures-mixed-before-payrolls/) . TIKR quoted investor Steve Eisman, who said on The Real Eisman Playbook that "Palantir is a partial AI play and the market has been freaking out about all AI plays."


As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-palantir-stock-popped-today-161553360.html) , investors were also reassessing the selloff that followed Palantir's[third-quarter report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) . That report showed revenue of $2.31 billion against the $2.18 billion analysts expected, and adjusted earnings of 44 cents per share versus a 41-cent forecast.


A separate[GuruFocus report](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/palantir-stocks-rise-5-96-183823596.html) linked the move to an NPR report that Palantir hired former Democratic Senator Jon Tester as an adviser. GuruFocus added that Palantir expects closer congressional scrutiny of its government work, including immigration-enforcement contracts.


## PLTR Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Per GuruFocus, U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% year over year to $984 million in the third quarter, surpassing U.S. government revenue of $953 million for the first time.
- GuruFocus reported that Palantir lifted its 2026 revenue forecast to about $8.53 billion and expects fourth-quarter revenue above $2.6 billion.


### Risks


- According to TIKR, total contract value grew only 6% in the third quarter, and the stock fell after the report despite revenue growth of 96%.
- TIKR said the shares dropped sharply on Thursday after[Democrats won both chambers of Congress](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/democratic-midterm-sweep-fallout-trump-blames-democrats-data-center-and-spacex-pushback/) , a result that sets up a fight over the Pentagon's budget.


TIKR said Palantir's next key test is its 2027 guidance, expected in early February. That timing is an estimate, not a confirmed release date.
